EvaluationStatus.description: How a compiler recommendation affected a planning decision.

oneOf.description: The compiler supported the initial decision.
The compiler led to a different decision.
The compiler identified a missed issue.
The compiler identified uncertainty requiring research.
There is insufficient evidence to assess value.

OutcomeSummary.description: A predicted or observed outcome summary, kept distinct by its enclosing event.

metrics.description: Metric values, keyed by metric name.

Usefulness.description: Whether using a compiler recommendation helped, independent of its [`EvaluationStatus`]: a confirmation can be useless and a change harmful.

oneOf.description: Using the recommendation improved the outcome or the decision.
Using the recommendation made no material difference.
Using the recommendation made the outcome worse.

description: An observed result linked to a prior decision.

actual_outcome.description: Measured result, separate from the decision's prediction.

confidence.description: Confidence in the evaluation, when known, in `[0, 1]`.

decision_id.description: ID of the decision this observation evaluates.

evaluation_status.description: How the compiler's recommendation affected the decision.

id.description: Stable event identifier supplied by the recorder.

plan_revision.description: Revision of the plan used for the event.

schema_version.description: Event schema version. PC-02 defines version 1.

source.description: Event producer, such as `pc-cli` or an agent identifier.

usefulness.description: Whether using the recommendation helped, assessed independently of `evaluation_status`; absent when not assessed.

title: OutcomeEvent
